submission_queue_doorbell.action: Host writes new 16-bit SQ Tail index; signals hardware DMA fetch

completion_queue_doorbell.action: Host writes new 16-bit CQ Head index; acknowledges completion reap

message_format_bits.endpoint_id: Bits [63:56] (8 bits): Identifies RTKit Mailbox endpoint (e.g. FTL, Power, NVMe Admin)
message_format_bits.message_type: Bits [55:48] (8 bits): Message opcode (Hello, Request, Response, Ping)
message_format_bits.sequence_id: Bits [47:32] (16 bits): Transaction sequence tag for matching async replies
message_format_bits.payload: Bits [31:0] (32 bits): Command-specific payload, status code, or memory token
